# See It at Your Desk {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #FF7A5C)"}

The same idea, on a Tuesday

## Same Question, Two Answers {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**Empty desk**

"Write the weekly update."

→ Generic filler. It doesn't know your team, your numbers, or your tone.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Loaded desk**

Paste the three team updates + last week's report.

→ A usable draft in your voice, with the real figures.
:::
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Same brain. Different desk. **Quality is a context problem.**
:::

# It All Clicks {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The payoff

## The Office Getting Smarter {auto-animate=true}

Everything you'll build this week is just **the app deciding what to re-send**:

::: {.incremental}
- **Standing instructions** — your rules, re-sent every time
- **Memory** — facts about you, re-sent when relevant
- **Skill** — a book in the library the app opens on command
- **Grounding** — your sources put on the desk, on purpose
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
None of it is magic. It's all **context management.**
:::

# Build: Your First Context Pack {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Five minutes — raw material for Day 2

## Write Down What It Would Always Need {auto-animate=true}

Pick **one task** from your backlog. Write the standing facts the AI would need **every
time** to do it well:

::: {.incremental}
- Who you are and your team / role
- The tone and format you always want
- The recurring facts (product names, the people, the rules)
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## Keep this
On Day 2 this becomes your **standing-instructions file** — write it once, never re-paste it.
:::

## Micro-Check {auto-animate=true}

The AI keeps signing emails with **the wrong job title**, every single time. Which layer
do you fix?

. . .

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #9B8EC0; color: white; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center;"}
**The App Layer** — it's missing a standing fact. Put your title in the context the app
re-sends, and it's fixed forever.
:::
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Two layers** — the model (brain) and the app (office) stacked together
2. **The brain has amnesia** — stateless, predicts the next word, can hallucinate
3. **Quality is a context problem** — the right pages on the desk → the right answer
4. **The desk has limits** — saved instructions beat re-pasting in a long chat
5. **It's all context management** — every Day-2/3 feature is just the app deciding what to re-send
:::
